meta.description: Tests a gene list or ranked gene vector against Reactome pathways with ReactomePA local annotations and documents ReactomeGSA as the comparative-service route.
meta.audit_kind: final-pass re-audit after private Linux runtime corrective; only retained e66 evidence is scored
meta.inputs_note: Each scored input used the retained agent-private WSL micromamba run directory and PID-recording runner. input07 is an unscored corroborating unsupported-organism control, excluded to avoid duplicating input06.

meta.env: private WSL science micromamba env reactome-phase1-private; R 4.4.3, ReactomePA 1.50.0, clusterProfiler 4.14.0, org.Hs.eg.db 3.20.0; all scored runners natural exit 0
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: Only retained e66 Linux evidence is scored; the older Windows exit-2816 evidence is described solely as the operational caveat.
